title: Introduction to Programming
description: Fundamentals of programming using variables, control flow, loops, and functions. Builds the foundation for every course that follows.

title: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation using Java and Python.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms 1
description: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and complexity analysis using Big-O notation.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms 2
description: Trees, graphs, heaps, hashing, and an introduction to dynamic programming.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms 3
description: Advanced string algorithms, dynamic programming, network flow, NP-completeness, and randomized algorithms.

title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript essentials for building interactive, responsive websites from scratch.

title: Frontend Frameworks
description: Building single-page applications with React, component design, and state management.

title: Full Stack Web Development
description: REST APIs, server-side rendering, authentication, and connecting a frontend to a backend service.

title: Mobile App Development
description: Building cross-platform mobile applications with React Native, covering navigation and device APIs.

title: Database Management Systems
description: Relational database design, SQL querying, normalization, indexing, and transaction management.

title: NoSQL and Distributed Databases
description: Document, key-value, and graph databases; consistency models and horizontal scaling strategies.

title: Probability and Statistics
description: Probability theory, random variables, distributions, hypothesis testing, and statistical inference.

title: Data Visualization
description: Principles of visual storytelling with data using charts, dashboards, and tools like Tableau and D3.js.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Supervised learning, regression, classification, decision trees, and model evaluation techniques.

title: Unsupervised Learning and Clustering
description: Clustering algorithms, dimensionality reduction, PCA, and anomaly detection techniques.

title: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks, backpropagation, convolutional and recurrent architectures for vision and language.

title: Natural Language Processing
description: Text preprocessing, embeddings, sequence models, and transformer-based language models.

title: Computer Vision
description: Image processing, feature extraction, object detection, and convolutional neural network architectures.

title: Computer Networks
description: Network protocols, the TCP/IP stack, routing, switching, and an introduction to network security.

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Common threats, cryptography basics, authentication mechanisms, and secure system design principles.

title: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
description: Vulnerability scanning, exploitation techniques, and reporting in a controlled, ethical testing environment.

title: Cryptography
description: Symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hashing, digital signatures, and cryptographic protocol design.

title: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, scheduling, memory management, and file systems.

title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
description: Cloud service models, virtualization, containerization with Docker, and deployment on AWS/Azure.

title: DevOps and CI/CD
description: Continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and container orchestration with Kubernetes.

title: Software Engineering Practices
description: Agile methodologies, version control, testing strategies, and collaborative software design.

title: System Design
description: Designing scalable systems: load balancing, caching, sharding, and distributed system trade-offs.

title: Capstone Project
description: A semester-long team project applying skills from the chosen specialization to a real-world problem.
